//! Evidence generator run only at the exact currently-published source revision.
//! Uses real native APIs; no synthetic SQL reconstruction of old receipts.
use std::path::Path;
use whipplescript_store::vcs::{BoundaryPromotionOutcome, NativeWorkspaceVcs};
use whipplescript_store::workstreams::{
    fork_at_cut_and_admit, BoundaryReservation, ExactForkDestination, WorkstreamStore,
    Workstreams,
};

fn save(path: &Path, value: &impl serde::Serialize) {
    use std::io::Write;
    let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .write(true)
        .create_new(true)
        .open(path)
        .unwrap();
    file.write_all(&serde_json::to_vec_pretty(value).unwrap()).unwrap();
}

fn stores(root: &Path) -> (WorkstreamStore, NativeWorkspaceVcs) {
    std::fs::create_dir(root).unwrap();
    let streams = WorkstreamStore::open(root.join("streams.sqlite")).unwrap();
    let vcs = NativeWorkspaceVcs::open(root.join("branches.sqlite"), root.join("content.sqlite")).unwrap();
    (streams, vcs)
}

fn main() {
    let root = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::args_os().nth(1).expect("new output directory"));
    std::fs::create_dir(&root).unwrap();
    let fork_root = root.join("fork");
    let (mut streams, mut vcs) = stores(&fork_root);
    vcs.init("t0").unwrap();
    vcs.create_branch("chat", None, "main", "t1").unwrap();
    vcs.bind_instance("parent", "chat", "t1").unwrap();
    vcs.write("chat", "state.txt", Some("point"), "chat-1", "t2").unwrap();
    vcs.write("chat", "state.txt", Some("new tip"), "chat-2", "t3").unwrap();
    vcs.create_branch("line", None, "main", "t3").unwrap();
    streams.create_stream("ws", None, "line", "t4", None).unwrap();
    streams.join("chat", "ws", "t4").unwrap();
    save(&fork_root.join("source-home.json"), &streams.home_receipt("chat").unwrap());
    let fork = fork_at_cut_and_admit(&mut streams, &mut vcs, "parent", "chat-1", "child", "chat-child", None,
        ExactForkDestination::Workstream("ws"), "t5").unwrap().receipt();
    assert_eq!(fork.outcome, "forked");
    save(&fork_root.join("fork.json"), &fork);
    drop(streams);
    drop(vcs);

    for mode in ["archived", "landed"] {
        let case = root.join(mode);
        let (mut streams, mut vcs) = stores(&case);
        vcs.init("t0").unwrap();
        vcs.write("main", "base", Some("base"), "main-1", "t1").unwrap();
        vcs.create_branch("line", None, "main", "t1").unwrap();
        vcs.write("line", "work", Some("work"), "line-1", "t2").unwrap();
        streams.create_stream("ws", None, "line", "t1", None).unwrap();
        streams.reserve_boundary("ws", BoundaryReservation {
            reservation_id: "reservation", expected_line_cut: "line-1", expected_main_cut: "main-1",
            proposed_main_cut: "main-2", at: "t2",
        }).unwrap();
        vcs.reserve_branch_head("line", "reservation", "t2").unwrap();
        let promoted = vcs.promote_line_exact("line", "reservation", Some("line-1"), Some("main-1"), "main-2", "t3").unwrap();
        let BoundaryPromotionOutcome::Promoted { ref_position, ref_receipt_handle, .. } = promoted else {
            panic!("unexpected promotion: {promoted:?}");
        };
        save(&case.join("accepted-ref.json"), &serde_json::json!({ "ref_position": ref_position, "ref_receipt_handle": ref_receipt_handle }));
        if mode == "archived" {
            streams.record_ref_advanced("ws", "reservation", ref_position, &ref_receipt_handle, "t3").unwrap();
            streams.close_promoted("ws", "reservation", "t4").unwrap();
            vcs.release_branch_head_reservation("line", "reservation").unwrap();
        }
        save(&case.join("boundary.json"), &streams.get_stream("ws").unwrap().unwrap().boundary_receipt("workspace").unwrap());
        // Closing the actual databases flushes the WAL; the landed case stops
        // before any topology receipt write, exactly like a process interruption.
        drop(streams);
        drop(vcs);
    }
    save(&root.join("provenance.json"), &serde_json::json!({
        "source_revision": "44302912257d49dbf033fe2543400c640f6fa71b",
        "crate_version": env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
        "generator": "crates/whipplescript-store/examples/mtarget_legacy_receipts.rs",
        "cases": ["fork", "archived", "landed"]
    }));
    println!("Legacy evidence written to {}", root.display());
}
